classification: Internal author-isolated holdout; authoring started after the parent reported candidate 47 already frozen.
freezeEvidenceBoundary: Candidate freeze is a parent-supplied assertion. This author did not inspect the candidate, its hash, its freeze record or any candidate content, and does not independently certify freeze chronology.

isolationDeclaration.assignmentReceived: The delegated authoring instruction and inherited conversation context. No additional parent task guidance or development work was opened.
isolationDeclaration.externalReads: Only checked whether the assigned output directory existed and listed its names if present; it did not exist. No repository source, memory registry, evaluation artifacts or other files were opened.
isolationDeclaration.sourceOfCases: Independently authored synthetic situations; no real people, contact data, credentials or private operational records.

scope.materialCountRange: 0 to 2 per case; this set uses 1, 1 and 2
scope.materialTargetLength: 400 to 1500 characters approximately for each material
scope.design: Concise requests delegate ordinary content design and decisions to the executor. Materials provide facts, background and current conditions, without a full answer or a canonical scoring solution.

seal: manifest.json records SHA-256 of every other sealed file; the final author message records SHA-256 of manifest.json. The manifest does not hash itself. Content must remain unopened by the parent until the parent explicitly unseals this set.
